purpose: Preflight identity memory for Aachu/Zuv face and clothes consistency before any image generation.

non_negotiable: dark wavy hair with visible volume
calm grounded expression, not a generic model face
medium-tall broader build relative to Aachu
clothing_and_detail_anchors: light blue or white shirt when story-relevant
dark shirt from close couch selfie when story-relevant

non_negotiable: playful dramatic energy under the softness
slightly smaller/petite presence relative to Himanshu
clothing_and_detail_anchors: red bag and red shoes as strong continuity props
pink-tinted glasses only when supported by reference context

identity_contact_sheet_guidance.option_id_rule: Use the ID labels printed on identity-face-contact-sheet.jpg when discussing or replacing references.
identity_contact_sheet_guidance.aachu_repair_rule: If Anchal/Aachu face is wrong, stop generation, choose 2-4 stronger Aachu face IDs from the contact sheet, rebuild the package with those identity images, and regenerate from slide 1.
identity_contact_sheet_guidance.zuv_repair_rule: If Himanshu/Zuv face is wrong, stop generation, choose 1-2 stronger Zuv face IDs from the contact sheet, rebuild the package with those identity images, and regenerate from slide 1.
identity_contact_sheet_guidance.hard_limit: Do not accept a pretty scene or correct text as final when either face fails likeness.

hard_fails: Generation starts without loading the identity contact sheet.
Generation starts without loading the selected identity references.
Prompt only describes the faces in text but does not use actual identity images.
Generated Himanshu/Zuv loses dark wavy hair, thick brows, beard/mustache, face structure, or build.
Generated Aachu/Anchal loses long dark hair, expressive eyes/brows, face structure, or soft dramatic energy.
A slide is accepted because the scene is pretty even though the faces are wrong.
limitations: This dossier inventories the local identity library and creates visual preflight anchors; it cannot mathematically guarantee model output likeness.
Final acceptance still requires visual QA against the identity references before packaging a slide as final.
